title: El Libro Que Compre --- The Word You Cannot Leave Out
label: ch:relative-obligatory
canDo: I can supply the que that English deletes.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C53-que-no-se-cae: produce el libro que compre and name the English pattern that always needs a que.
payoff.note: The error that outlives the others, because the learner thinks the English first and the gap is invisible. English can delete the joint because its word order is rigid; Spanish moves its pieces, so it cannot.
